title: PRJCT CrossFit vs Studio Rubix
meta_desc: Compare PRJCT CrossFit and Studio Rubix NZ. Price, contract, facilities, and overall value. Choose the best gym for your fitness needs.
intro: PRJCT CrossFit and Studio Rubix NZ are two boutique gyms offering unique workout experiences. PRJCT CrossFit is ideal for CrossFit enthusiasts, while Studio Rubix focuses on reformer pilates and holistic health. This comparison will help you decide which gym suits your fitness goals and budget.

sections.heading: Pricing and Contract
sections.body: PRJCT CrossFit prices range from $45.00 to $65.00 per week, with no joining fee. Studio Rubix NZ prices range from $20.00 to $50.00 per week, also with no joining fee. Both gyms offer flexible, no-lock-in contracts, allowing members to cancel anytime.
list: No joining fee for both gyms

sections.heading: Facilities and Locations
sections.body: PRJCT CrossFit features group fitness classes, personal training, and free weights. Studio Rubix NZ offers reformer pilates, personal training, and nutrition coaching. PRJCT CrossFit has locations in selected cities, while Studio Rubix NZ is primarily in Palmerston North.
list: PRJCT CrossFit: group fitness, personal training, free weights
Studio Rubix NZ: reformer pilates, personal training, nutrition coaching

sections.heading: Verdict and Recommendation
sections.body: Consider your fitness goals and budget when choosing between PRJCT CrossFit and Studio Rubix NZ. If you're a CrossFit enthusiast, PRJCT CrossFit is the better choice. For those interested in reformer pilates and holistic health, Studio Rubix NZ is the way to go. Eligible members can also explore Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, offering 40-70% off membership prices. Ultimately, both gyms provide unique benefits, and it's essential to visit and experience them before making a decision.
list: Reformer pilates and holistic health: Studio Rubix NZ
Eligible members: Exercise NZ subsidised gym scheme
